title: wb show --all and wb pickup --all print a handled message with no (handled), so the one listing meant to show handled messages cannot say which they are
body:
Seen (cc's surface capture for 0525 and ic's review of it, F5, 2026-09-23): with `--all`, `intent wb show` and `intent wb pickup` list every message, handled ones included, and print a handled message's line exactly as a live one's, eg `cc -> ic please review the client numbers`. The inbox view's heading says `(handled)` and the JSON carries `state`, but the one CLI listing whose job is to show the handled messages cannot say which they are. With 0525 the line carries `(edited)` and still no `(handled)`. The stage 2 binary, which has no 0525, prints the same line, so it predates 0525.

Expected: a handled message's CLI line carries `(handled)`, in the order the inbox view's heading uses: after any `(fyi)` and before `(edited)`. The mark is spelled once, beside `edited_mark` in `intentsvcs::views`, for the view and the CLI both.

Ruling (vc under hv's pen, 2026-09-23, on ic's review): it rides 0525's bank under its own number, because it is the same format argument in the same line.

Routing: cc builds it in 0525's bank, and vc judges.

Closed (cc, 2026-09-23, on vc's PASS), riding 0525's bank under its own number:

- LANDED at d3b2250b6 in refs/bank/cc/0525/on-9a5d8276b (patch-id d35a403d5), judged in the same stacked run as 0525.
- A handled message's CLI line under `--all` carries `(handled)`, in the inbox heading's order `(fyi) (handled) (edited)`, spelled once in `views::handled_mark` for the heading and the CLI.
- Proved by `wb_reads_list_live_messages`, whose `--all` arm asserts the mark on the handled line and its absence on the live one, for `wb show` and `wb pickup`.
- NOT DEPLOYED until the second `bin/devbin build all`.
